name: tinyassets-mobile
description: TinyAssets mobile app: a Capacitor native shell (Android + iOS) over the live TinyAssets web app (https://tinyassets.io/app).

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && python scripts/configure_android_release.py && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && python scripts/configure_android_release.py && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
